correctness.rationale: Independent parent choices imply exact two-color Pólya urn rising-factorial moments E W=(j-1)/i and E[W(W+1)]=2(j-1)j/(i(i+1)); conditioning on the position of vertex j gives E Z|A=2j/(i+1), E Z|not A=j/(i+1). The subsequent nested/disjoint Dirichlet-multinomial covariances are nm(j-Z)/[j²(j+1)] and -nmZ/[j²(j+1)], respectively. E[S_j|F_j]=n/j is constant, eliminating between-composition covariance. Conditional sign formulas follow, weighted by 1/i and (i-1)/i cancel exactly. Conditioning on the largest possible S_i proves strict dependence for interior pair indices. Boundary cases deterministic. Exact exhaustive checker enumerated all recursive trees through n=9, 1,022 rational assertions; this is auxiliary finite evidence only.

value.rationale: Pairwise tagged descendant sizes are natural random-growth observables. A complete all-index orthogonality classification together with strict nonindependence and opposite ancestor/disjoint conditional covariances provides a structural fact not supplied by one-node marginals. The outcome explains why second-order linear correlation misses nested/disjoint dependence, and includes sharp deterministic boundary cases. Its significance is confined to this model, not a claim of a downstream general theorem.
